info.title: ApiToolKit - Google BigQuery API
info.description: ASP.NET Core Clean Architecture integration for Google BigQuery API. Covers OAuth 2.0 authentication, Datasets, Tables, Jobs (Query, Load, Extract, Copy), Streaming Insert, and Routines.

get.summary: Get the OAuth 2.0 authorization URL for BigQuery.
Handle OAuth 2.0 callback and exchange code for tokens.

post.summary: Refresh an access token using a refresh token.

get.summary: List all datasets in a project.

post.summary: Run a synchronous query against BigQuery.

get.summary: Get query results for a completed job.

post.summary: Stream rows into a table using the insertAll API.
Create a new asynchronous job (query, load, or extract).

get.summary: Get the status and details of a job.

post.summary: Create a new routine (UDF, stored procedure, or table function).

get.summary: List all tables in a dataset.

post.summary: Copy a table to another dataset or project.
